implementation_ontology.mapping_covariates: PCR N threads/block, CR N/2, scalar sweeps256, float4 sweep64 with original oversized grid4*ceil(M/256) blocks, transpose16x16 padded272FP32 shared. Preserve source PCR N+1 shared strides and CR N strides, both allocated5*(N+1)FP32; CR redundant identical writes of the final two unknowns retained, no formal race-freedom claim. CUDAjl dynamic shared, KA static localmem, JACC dynamic shared/global-template copy and initializer barrier; sweep private128FP32 represented by StaticArrays.MVector, float4 by four-register SVector arithmetic, actual spills/vector instructions unprofiled. KA excludes entry returns, helper sweep return and complete-tile host precondition preserve named valid-domain behavior. All3 use own framework device kernels; no CUDA device-extension or vendor solve in KA/JACC. Native FMA contraction versus plain Julia operations observed in scoped PTX, not a causal speed explanation.
implementation_ontology.precision_scope: Timed FP32 coefficients, RHS, solutions and elimination arithmetic, Int32 addressing; Float64 artifact encoding and CPU residual evaluation are verification roles. All controls fixed before GPU: atol2e-5/rtol2e-4 against Fraction Thomas solutions and every global elimination coefficient, plus normwise backward error<=1e-5 for each system. Actual maximal solution error native5.13064153e-6 / Julia3.22329290e-6; maximal workspace error7.66741884e-5, maximal backward error6.21153588e-8. Native and Julia saved outputs form two SHA classes; no bit-identity claim. Actual inputs/guards/non-output states checked exactly.
implementation_ontology.support_boundary: Four dominant dyadic fixtures N16/32/64/128 with M16/32/64/256 and varied signed manufactured solutions, plus original choice0 source initializer N128M16. Valid source power-of-two system sizes<=128; all reorder dimensions multiples16 and vector batch counts divisible4. Original M524288/three CLI executions/R100 not measured; source PCR/CR repeats across CLI variants are deduplicated into the nine distinct paths.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Solve independent coupled tridiagonal systems using PCR, CR and Thomas/sweep strategies
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Parallel cyclic reduction, cyclic reduction with backward substitution, scalar/private/four-system sweeps, optional five-transpose data reordering
scientific_intent.numerical_risk: Elimination conditioning and roundoff, layout/endpoint indexing, invalid partial transpose tiles or partial vector batches; original checker only prints averaged error, new full oracle rejects independently
scientific_intent.validation_target: All45 complete batch solutions and defined physical workspaces/inputs/guards, exact Fraction solutions/elimination coefficients and per-system FP64 backward error
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Choose batched tridiagonal algorithms and data layouts for line solves in PDE/transport methods; these are controlled operator tests, not a full PDE prediction certificate
